queries:
WITH per_sex AS (
    SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(CAST(L.CPK AS REAL) / L.GPT) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE L.CPK IS NOT NULL AND L.GPT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY P.SEX
),
first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m1 FROM per_sex
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, p.avg_ratio
    FROM per_sex p, first_mean f
    WHERE p.avg_ratio > f.m1
),
second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m2 FROM kept
),
final AS (
    SELECT k.SEX, k.avg_ratio
    FROM kept k, second_mean s
    WHERE k.avg_ratio > s.m2
)
SELECT
    AVG(fi.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_final,
    AVG(fi.avg_ratio - f.m1) AS avg_diff_first_mean,
    AVG(fi.avg_ratio - s.m2) AS avg_diff_second_mean
FROM final fi, first_mean f, second_mean s
SELECT ID, Date, CPK / GPT AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE CPK IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT <> 0;
SELECT ID, Date, CAST(GOT AS REAL) / GPT AS ratio
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GPT IS NOT NULL AND GPT <> 0;
